actual_scope: Exact sign, triangle, cover and capacity facts for routing the P104 residual through lives used as wires, and an obstruction for the minimal pollution-free wire architecture (partner chain {0}->G->Q, one live wire per Q, no helpers).
scope_change_reason: The card asks about joint helper bases; this package studies the extreme case of replacing last-mile helpers by lives and shows its minimal form is infeasible.
bottleneck_link: Helper lifetimes (pollution bookkeeping at F0 and F9) are the largest R0 component of the P104 local word; removing helpers by using lives as wires was the natural route to cut them. This side result bounds that route.
stop_rule: Stop once the minimal wire architecture is either constructed or excluded; the helper-assisted variant is a separate scope.
evidence: verify.py V1-V6 (exhaustive over all ports, pairs, triples and 24-port frames) with two failure controls; Lean proofs of Lemmas 1-2 in lean/WireSigns.lean; hand proof of Lemma 5 in PROOF.md.

open_questions.question: Is 'lives as wires plus one helper per partner G-frame' cheaper than two polluted helpers per partner?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the cheapest architecture not excluded here; crude chain-tax lower bounds leave a large margin below the current word.
